audit_items.scope_rationale: The verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch function is implemented in the external c-kzg-4844 library (vendor/github.com/ethereum/c-kzg-4844), not in Prysm's codebase. Prysm only provides a Go wrapper in beacon-chain/blockchain/kzg/kzg.go:108 that delegates to ckzg4844.VerifyCellKZGProofBatch(). Bug bounty scope covers Prysm code, not external cryptographic library dependencies. The bounds checking, array access validation, and coset_for_cell/coset_shift_for_cell implementations are all in the external C library.

While Prysm does have input validation in beacon-chain/blockchain/kzg/validation.go, the actual memory safety of commitment deserialization is handled by the external library.
